I'm short so I like to be exact with what I take in my body so naturally I'm measuring everything I put on my plate with a scale. She all of a sudden walks over and is practically breathing down my neck! "What are you doing?" Calculating macros... "What's a macro?" Well basically portions "Is this on a meal plan?"
